# Frontiers for Young Minds

> Open-access science journal bringing peer-reviewed research to kids aged 8-15, with unique involvement of young reviewers in the editorial process.

Frontiers for Young Minds bridges the gap between cutting-edge scientific research and young audiences by adapting complex studies into accessible articles. The journal uniquely empowers children to participate as peer reviewers, editors, and contributors, fostering science literacy and youth engagement in the scientific community.

## Core Content

- [Frontiers for Young Minds Homepage](https://kids.frontiersin.org): Homepage for open-access journal bringing latest research to kids aged 8-15
- [Articles](https://kids.frontiersin.org/articles): Browsable directory of peer-reviewed scientific articles for young readers
- [Collections](https://kids.frontiersin.org/collections): Curated themed collections of research articles suitable for classroom use
- [Journal](https://kids.frontiersin.org/about/journal): About page explaining journal's unique peer-review model with young reviewers

## Research Sections by Topic

- [Astronomy and Physics](https://kids.frontiersin.org/sections/astronomy-and-physics): Section featuring articles on space science, galaxies, planets, and universe
- [Neuroscience and Psychology](https://kids.frontiersin.org/sections/neuroscience-and-psychology): Section on brain science, behavior, learning, and human development
- [Earth Sciences](https://kids.frontiersin.org/sections/earth-sciences): Section on earth science, climate, marine science, sustainability, and resources
- [Biodiversity](https://kids.frontiersin.org/sections/biodiversity): Section exploring biological diversity, ecology, conservation, and species
- [Engineering and Technology](https://kids.frontiersin.org/sections/engineering-and-technology): Section exploring engineering disciplines and technological innovations
- [Chemistry and Materials](https://kids.frontiersin.org/sections/chemistry-and-materials): Section covering chemical compounds, materials science, and their applications
- [Mathematics and Economics](https://kids.frontiersin.org/sections/mathematics-and-economics): Section on mathematics, pure/applied math, microeconomics, macroeconomics

## Participation & Roles

- [Young Minds - Peer Reviewers](https://kids.frontiersin.org/participate/young-minds): Information for young reviewers to participate in peer-review process
- [Author Guidelines](https://kids.frontiersin.org/participate/authors): Guidelines for authors on adapting research for younger audiences
- [Editors & Mentors](https://kids.frontiersin.org/participate/editors-and-mentors): Guidelines for science mentors and editors to join the platform
- [Teachers & Parents](https://kids.frontiersin.org/participate/teachers-and-parents): Resources for educators to use articles in classroom learning activities

## Language Versions

- [English](https://kids.frontiersin.org/en): English language homepage for open-access science journal for kids
- [French](https://kids.frontiersin.org/fr): French language version of open-access journal for young scientists
- [Hebrew](https://kids.frontiersin.org/he): Hebrew language version of open-access science journal for youth
